svg.title: Gov Support RAG Chatbot — Full Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture diagram covering ingestion, retrieval, generation, API, infra, and observability layers

g.text: Docling · PDF / HTML / CSV / Telugu OCR · Chunking strategy · Metadata tagging
